criteria.criterion:
`vloop fence check --phase work --root --tool [--path

] [""]` gives every decision of the brief's two worked-example tables and its apply_patch lines; where the brief shows a message, the deny line is `deny: ` followed by that message without its `vloop fence: ` prefix (the prefix is the hook's, as for review).
criteria.evidence: internal/fence/judge_test.go TestWorkShell and TestWorkOtherTools cover every row of both tables with exact reasons, plus the two apply_patch lines; the go check passed.

criteria.criterion: Shell in work: the same splitting, unwrapping and outright denials as review (backtick, `$(`, `<(`, `>(`, `eval`, `source`, `.`, unterminated quote, non-literal `-c` string, command word starting with `$`, the shell keywords, subshells); a simple command is denied by a `Bash(…)` deny rule of the embedded `fence/work.json` (`<command> is denied by the work fence (Bash(<rule>))`) or a work deny-list stem (`<command> is denied by the Copilot deny list (<stem>)`). The rules and stems are read from the embedded fence and the adapter's list; a second hand-copied rule list is a violation.
criteria.evidence: judge.go New loads vloop.Fence("work") and driver.CopilotDenyStems(), with no copied list; the shell path is shared with review; match() labels the fence by phase. Tests cover $(, backtick, eval, for-loop, sh -c and env unwrapping.

criteria.criterion: Writes in work (`create`, `edit`, `apply_patch`, a redirection) resolve against --root as in review and are allowed anywhere under the root except under `.git/` or under `.vloop/` outside `.vloop/tmp/` (`write to <path> is not allowed in a work session: nothing under .git/ or .vloop/ but .vloop/tmp/`) and outside the root (`write to <path> is not allowed in a work session: it is outside the repository`); `/dev/null` is allowed.
criteria.evidence: judge.go workWrite, with the /dev/null early return in write(). Tests assert exact messages, including the .vloop/tmp/../state/x traversal case.

criteria.criterion: Reads in work as in review; `skill` only for one of the embedded plugin's skills, else `skill <name> is not vloop's — use /vloop:work`; every other tool, `web_fetch`, `task` and names ending in `_subagent`: `tool <name> is not allowed in a work session`.
criteria.evidence: Decide uses the shared read case, skillPhase() gives /vloop:work, and the default branch uses j.phase. TestWorkOtherTools asserts the exact messages for web_fetch, task and explore_subagent.

criteria.criterion: `rm` of a file is allowed in work; `rm -rf`, `rm -r`, `rm -R`, `rm -fr` and the rest of the work fence's recursive rules deny; `pnpm add`, `npm install` and `node x.js` are allowed and `pip install` and `sh script.sh` are denied, as the brief decides.
criteria.evidence: New drops the rm:* stem for work only. TestWorkShell has cases for all of these.

criteria.criterion:
An unknown phase is a usage error, exit 2, with `unknown phase "

": want review, second-review or work`.
criteria.evidence: The New error text matches and TestUnknownPhase asserts it. The fence_hook_test.go fail-closed cases now use "plan" for the unknown phase. I did not trace the exit-2 mapping in cli/fence.go; it is unchanged and the message arrives through the same path.

criteria.criterion: The review and second-review phases decide and word every call exactly as before — `rm src/old.ts` with `--phase review` is still `deny: rm src/old.ts is denied by the Copilot deny list (rm:*)`, exit 1. The existing judge tests that pin `work` as an unknown phase change only to the new behaviour, and the work notes name the contract item (W1).
criteria.evidence: The review paths are unchanged apart from the phase-parameterised labels, which render as "review" for review phases. TestReviewStillDeniesRm covers both review phases. The two tests that pinned work as unknown now say "W1" or use "plan".

criteria.criterion: The work phase's rules are covered by committed Go table tests in `internal/fence` that run on every OS in the `go` check, covering every line of the worked example's two tables and the path rules; a work phase with no committed tests is a violation.
criteria.evidence: TestWorkShell, TestWorkOtherTools and TestReviewStillDeniesRm in internal/fence/judge_test.go; the go check log shows ok.

criteria.criterion: No Claude session's argv, fence file or settings changes, and `fence/work.json` and `fence/review.json` are unchanged.
criteria.evidence: git status shows no change under fence/ or in the Claude driver code; only the judge, the fence CLI text, tests and docs/guide/commands.md changed.
